status: Frozen before preparing or predicting test-role galaxies; first test-role model scoring
eligibility: Original test role, E morphology, available spectroscopic dispersion, finite published Salpeter mass, positive updated I-band radius
primary_comparison: Frozen wave versus frozen common-stellar-mass benchmark; also report original ordinary-mass baseline
preserved_assumptions: Same conditional Salpeter luminosity normalization, energy-loss-plus-event-stretch branch, archived static geometry, Hernquist profiles, 3 arcsec aperture, 1.5 arcsec Gaussian seeing
primary_score: Same equal-weight mean squared log dispersion and lens-angle residual score used in training; lower is better
secondary_metrics: Both RMS errors, median ratios, mean biases, per-object predictions and all exclusions
interpretation: Conditional predictive test of calibrated profiles, not a full uncertainty likelihood, pristine data blinding or proof of photon origin
history: Public catalog and some aggregate sample information previously accessed; no prior model predictions or residual selection for test-role systems
failure_handling: Keep numerical failures explicit and do not omit systems based on outcomes
future_use: After this run the test residuals are exposed. Later changes require a new independent test sample.
